title: Card Maven event envelope
description: CloudEvents-style envelope shared by every Kafka event. Mirrors card_maven.shared.events.Event.

id.description: Unique per event; consumers deduplicate on it.

type.description: <context>.<entity>.<action>.v<N>. The topic is the type without its version.

subject.description: Partition key; events about one subject stay ordered.

data.description: Payload, validated by the event type's own schema.
